files.notes: The spike's small.docx. Normal is Calibri, docDefaults resolve to the template's minor font Cambria: both are metric-compatible, so FONT negative. LibreOffice 26.8.3.1 renders it as 2 pages (wave two, round B), not the 1 page that docs/m0-spikes.md first said. docx-one-page is the one-page file of the overhead gate.

The spike's document with two paragraphs instead of four, built to fit one page: the warm one-page DOCX of the overhead gate (INTERFACES.md section 11). Page count recorded from LibreOffice 26.8.3.1 in rs-convert-lead-runtime:wave2a on 2026-11-26: 1 page, no warning.

docx-small rewritten so that word/document.xml is stored (method 0) with a data descriptor (flag bit 3), as Go's archive/zip writes it: the local header has zero CRC and sizes. LibreOffice 26.8.3.1 cannot load it (lane 004, image mode: LoadFailed, loadComponentFromURL returned an empty reference), so the service answers 422 CONVERSION_FAILED. The case expects that answer, so a fix such as repacking in the worker turns it into a visible failure to update.

docx-small with word/document.xml deflated and carrying a data descriptor: the boundary next to docx-stored-descriptor. A deflated entry ends itself, so LibreOffice is expected to load it (unverified until the next real-engine run).

The spike's long.docx, undoctored: app.xml says 1 page and the spike rendered about 35. DOCX V1 is off, so no PAGE_COUNT_MISMATCH. Page count recorded from LibreOffice 26.8.3.1 in rs-convert-lead-runtime:wave2a on 2026-11-26.
12 pages from 11 hard page breaks. app.xml keeps the template's Pages 1 and Microsoft Macintosh Word: the V1 negative case.

Page 2 holds only an empty paragraph after a page break; LibreOffice drops a break that nothing follows, so the generator adds that paragraph. The rendered page is flat but has no objects: BLANK negative.
Theme minor font Aptos; runs use minorHAnsi and Normal names no font. FONT positive through the theme.
Heading 1 takes the theme major font, set to Aptos Display; Heading 2 is a literal Calibri Light; Normal is Calibri; docDefaults are the minor font Cambria.

5 slides, slides 2 and 4 with show=0. V1 negative for the hidden-slide logic.

sldIdLst lists 4 slides. The 4th part's root is p:notASlide. LibreOffice 26.8.3.1 does not drop that slide: it renders a blank 4th page, so there is no page-count mismatch, and the V1 positive is a lane 001 unit test (lead ruling, wave two round B). LibreOffice paints a white background on every slide, so the empty page has objects, renders flat and raises BLANK_PAGE.
Theme major and minor font Aptos. Layout 11, which no slide uses, names Zzyzx Grotesk: unreached layouts are not scanned.
The spike's photo deck: 10 full-bleed 1600 x 900 JPEG photos with seeded noise.
60 full-bleed 1366 x 768 JPEG photos, about 32 MiB.

LibreOffice paints a white background on the one page, so it has objects, renders flat and raises BLANK_PAGE (lead ruling: keep V3).
Hand-written ODF presentation with 3 draw:page elements.

100,000 x 10 numbers in one sheet. The PDF likely exceeds MAX_RENDER_PAGES, so the bundle renders pages 1-5 only. Hand-written ODF spreadsheet, 20 x 3 numbers.

Hand-written 3-page A4 PDF. The dpi-600 case assumes the default MAX_DPI of 300. PDFs have no pre-flight. The webp-refused case keeps the removal of WebP output tested (owner decision): lane 001 answers an unknown image format with 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

640 x 480 RGB gradient. Image inputs are out of v1 (owner decision, 2026-11-26), so detection answers 415 UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT before any engine runs.
The same gradient as JPEG, quality 85. Image inputs are out of v1 (owner decision, 2026-11-26), so detection answers 415 UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT before any engine runs.

A2 holds =_xlfn.WEBSERVICE("http://127.0.0.1:47123/ws"), as Excel stores the function.
word/document.xml declares 2 GiB of zeros, deflated to about 2 MB (zip64).
docx-small with a billion-laughs DTD in word/document.xml. Either outcome passes if it comes within the deadline.

A complete 1-bit grayscale PNG of 100,000 x 100,000 pixels, about 1.2 MB. Image inputs are out of v1 (owner decision, 2026-11-26), so detection answers 415 UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT before any engine runs. It stays as a detection case: the bomb must never reach a decoder.
